# Task Template — Training Mode

This template converts a sprint into actionable training tasks for an intern-level developer.

---

## Task Title

Short, clear description of the work.

Example:

Create Login Endpoint

---

## Objective

Explain what the student should achieve.

Example:

Implement a POST /auth/login endpoint that validates credentials and returns a JWT token.

---

## Context

Explain why this task exists.

Example:

Authentication is required to protect private routes and identify users.

---

## Steps

1. Create controller method
2. Validate input
3. Call service
4. Return response

---

## Expected Result

Describe observable behavior.

Example:

User sends email and password and receives a JWT token.

---

## Manual Test

Steps to verify behavior.

Example:

POST /auth/login

Expected:

Status 200
Token returned

---

## Definition of Done

- Code compiles
- No console errors
- Feature works
- Manual test executed
- Commit created

---

## Estimated Time

Example:

1 hour

---

## Difficulty

Easy
Medium
Hard

---

## Status

Todo
In Progress
Done
